risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (389.12) with imminent FOMC event (0 days) creates severe near-term volatility risk; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide limited offset; 84-day earnings window adds secondary risk layer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Structural bullish alignment (price above EMA-200, supertrend bullish, ichimoku above cloud, ADX bullish) with extreme market fear (34/100) creating contrarian buy opportunity at support level (13.4753).
debate.key_bear_argument: Momentum deterioration (MACD crossover down, RSI-14 overbought without confirmation, stochrski oversold), zero fundamental catalysts, imminent FOMC event with VIX crisis (389.12), and 84-day earnings risk create a high-probability pullback scenario before any sustained move.

decision.entry_rationale: Structural bullish alignment (price above EMA-200, supertrend, ichimoku) and extreme fear (34/100) create contrarian appeal.
